title: El mundo de los dinosaurios
who: un nene de 10-11 años, nivel B1: frases más largas en inglés con errores típicos de su nivel

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of dinosaurs. Look, I have a big dino friend right here! Can you tell me, what is your favorite dinosaur?
Um… I like the T‑rex, because it big.
The T-rex is amazing! You are right, it is a big dinosaur. Do you think it was the biggest one of all, or was there another one even larger?
Um… maybe the Argentinosaurus is bigger, I think?
Wow, excellent choice! I think the Argentinosaurus is bigger too because it was truly massive. Why do you think such a giant dinosaur needed to be so big?
Um… maybe because it need... a lot of food, many plants…?

That makes total sense! I think it needed to be that big because it needed to eat a lot of plants to have enough energy. What do you think about the baby dinosaurs? Do you think they started as a small egg?

eval.verdict: Recast excelente (reformula 'need' sin señalar) y afecto cálido. Pero el tono es demasiado pedagógico/formulaico ('Wow, excellent choice!') y falta reciclado horizontal de vocab. Conversación auténtica pero visiblemente diseñada.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the amazing world of dinosaurs. Look, I have a big dino toy here! Tell me, what kind of dinosaur do you like the most?
I love the T‑rex the most because it is biggest and it can roar very loud, I wish I can see it in real life! Do you have a favorite dinosaur too?
That is a great choice! The T-rex is definitely the most powerful dinosaur. I think the Triceratops is my favorite because it has three cool horns. Why do you think the T-rex is so loud?
Because it have huge lungs and a giant mouth, the sound become so loud that you can hear it far away, and it looks very scary! What do you think about the T‑rex teeth?

The T-rex has huge lungs and sharp teeth, so you are right, it sounds incredibly loud! I think their teeth are terrifying because they are so pointy. Do you think they used their sharp teeth to hunt for food?

Yes, I think they used their sharp teeth to hunt other animals because the teeth is very strong and can cut big animals, and sometimes they could also eat dead meat. What you think about the Velociraptor, is it also a good hunter?
That is a great point! I think the Velociraptor is a clever hunter because it was very fast and agile. Why do you think they were so fast compared to other dinosaurs?

eval.verdict: Profe cálido, conversacional, recircula bien y valida constantemente. Pero miss de recast en 3 errores gramaticales claros: 'I wish I can'→could, 'teeth is'→are, 'What you think'→do you think.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, your explorer friend. Today, we are traveling back in time to the amazing world of dinosaurs! I just found a giant, mysterious egg in the jungle. What do you think is inside this big egg?
I think maybe a big dino, like a triceratops or maybe a bird dinosaur, but I not sure. Also my brother left his bike in the kitchen.

Wow, a triceratops would be incredible! I think that it is a big dinosaur because the egg is so heavy. That is funny about your brother's bike in the kitchen, but what makes you think it is a triceratops?
I think the egg have three horns like a triceratops, maybe because I saw a picture in my book, but also I wonder why my brother's bike smell weird.

That is fascinating! You think the egg has three horns because of the picture in your book. I love how you look for clues. Do you think a baby triceratops would be very loud or quiet inside that shell?
I think the baby triceratops be quiet, because the shell is like a soft pillow, but my mom singing loud in the kitchen make me think it could be noisy too.
That is a great observation! You think the baby triceratops would be quiet because the shell is soft like a pillow. Do you agree that a big dinosaur would need a very large nest to be comfortable?

eval.verdict: Excelente afecto (celebra constantemente) y recast suave que no asusta. Input bien calibrado para B1. Pero el flujo es algo lineal (pregunta→reformula→nueva pregunta); las tangencias del alumno (brother's bike, mom singing) se ignoran gentilmente pero no se investigan ni se reutilizan pedagógicamente.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, your adventure partner. Today we are exploring a mysterious dinosaur forest! I just found a giant, glowing dino egg hidden in the bushes. What do you think is inside this big egg?
I think maybe a huge baby T‑Rex is inside, because the egg glowing and it looks like a secret treasure. The dinosaur forest is very scary but also very exciting!

Wow, I think a huge baby T-Rex is a brilliant guess because the egg is glowing so bright. It sounds like you are feeling brave in that exciting forest! What was the most amazing thing you saw while we were walking there?
I saw a enormous fern that were taller than my head, and many pterodactils flying above the trees, it made me feel like an explorer in a secret world.
That sounds incredible! I think you were an explorer in a secret world because you saw enormous ferns and pterodactyls flying above the trees. Did you feel like you were flying too?
I felt like I was flying, because the wind was very strong and the pterodactils was near me. My heart was beating fast like a drum in the forest.
That is amazing! I think your heart was beating like a drum because the wind was strong and the pterodactyls were flying so close to you. Do you think they were friendly or were they just curious?

eval.verdict: Profe narrativo, afectivo. Recasts fluidos (fern→ferns, pterodactils was→pterodactyls were). Input B1 bien calibrado. Reciclado: podría ser más sistemático con 'forest', 'egg', 'pterodactyls'.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of the dinosaurs. Look, I found a big dino egg! Tell me, have you ever seen a dinosaur before?
Uhm... no... I never see a real dinosaur... only in TV.
That is so cool! You said you have never seen a real dinosaur, only one on TV. I think watching them on TV is amazing because they look so real! What kind of dinosaur is your favorite?
Uhm... I... I like... the T-Rex. Because... it's big and scary. But I never see one real. Only in movies.
I agree, the T-Rex is incredible! You think it is amazing because it is so big and scary. You have never seen a real one, but you have seen them in movies. Which other dinosaur do you like?
Uhm... I... I like... the Triceratops. Because... it have three horns. And... it's cool. But... I never see it. Only pictures.
That is a great choice! You like the Triceratops because it has three horns, and you have seen it in pictures. Since you love dinosaurs, do you think they were friendly or scary?

eval.verdict: Profe sólido: celebra, reformula errores sin señalar, invita a producir. Patrón de recast muy marcado ('You think...', 'You said...') quita fluidez, pero el alumno timado gana confianza y produce.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of dinosaurs! I just found a giant, mysterious nest. Look, this is a big dino egg. What do you see in the nest?

That is a great question! A baby dinosaur hatches from the egg when it is ready. I think it is amazing! We should be very careful, but we can look closely. Do you think a big dino is inside?
Profe, I think maybe a T-Rex baby is inside because that egg looks super big! Can we hear it make sounds?? I really want to see what color the baby dinosaur is when it comes out!

eval.verdict: Profe naturalmente entusiasta, recasts implícitos de calidad, i1 bien calibrado. Falta reciclado más denso de 'mysterious' y 'hide' + follow-up guiado tras recast para que alumno produzca la forma correcta.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of the dinosaurs. Look, I found a big dino egg! What do you think is inside?

eval.verdict: Afecto excepcional (celebra 'creative guess', 'great idea', adapta a intereses del alumno). Input seguro, bien calibrado para B1. Debilidad: teatralidad excesiva ('misión', 'viajes temporales') que simula narrativa en lugar de conversación. Need-for-output cumplida.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of dinosaurs! I just found a giant, mysterious egg. What do you think is inside this big egg?
I think it can be a baby dinosaur! Maybe a T-Rex or a Triceratops. I hope it's not a carnivore because they eat meat and they are very dangerous!
That is a brilliant idea! I think it is a baby dinosaur too because the egg is so massive. Do you think a T-Rex would be a scary neighbor to have?
Yeah, a T-Rex would be super scary as a neighbor! It would probably eat my dog and stomp on my house!
Oh no, that would be terrible! I think a T-Rex would be a very scary neighbor because it is so huge. What kind of dinosaur would be a better neighbor for you?
I think a Triceratops would be a better neighbor because it eats plants and it has those cool horns but it's not as aggressive as a T-Rex!
That is a great point! I agree that a Triceratops would be much friendlier because it eats plants. If you had a Triceratops as a neighbor, what would you name it?

eval.verdict: Celebra bien y calibra input; pero sigue patrón mecánico (validación→pregunta). Podría profundizar en las respuestas del alumno en vez de avanzar a la siguiente.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of dinosaurs. Look, I have a big dino fossil right here! What do you see in our adventure today?
... Uh... big. Bones? ... Yes.
Exactly, those are big dinosaur bones! It is amazing to see how huge they were. I think this dino was very strong because of its large tail. What do you think about it?
... Tail... long. Maybe... eat trees? ... I think.
That is a great point! I think that it ate trees because it had such a long neck to reach the high branches. Do you agree that long-necked dinosaurs were plant eaters?
... Uh... yes. Plants... good. ... Maybe... strong legs too?
That is a brilliant idea! I think it needed strong legs because it was a giant animal. What do you think, was it faster than a small egg?

eval.verdict: Afecto y celebración fuertes, pero prescribe el tópico en lugar de co-construirlo. La pregunta «¿más rápido que un huevo pequeño?» es lógicamente absurda y mata la coherencia conversacional.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are exploring the amazing world of dinosaurs! Look at this big dino right here. What do you think about it?

Oh wow! He is so big, like... much bigger than my house! I think he is a T-Rex, right? My brother have a lot of dinosaur toys, and he says the T-Rex is the most strongest dinosaur of all. Do you think it's true?
That is a huge T-Rex! My brother has many toys too, and I think he is right because the T-Rex was definitely the strongest. Do you agree that the T-Rex is the coolest dinosaur?

Yeah, definitely! I think the T-Rex is the coolest, but the Triceratops is very cool too, because of the horns! My friend Leo says the Stegosaurus is good because it have a spiky tail, but... I don't know, the T-Rex is more... scary, you know?
You are right, the T-Rex is really scary! Leo thinks the Stegosaurus is good because it has a spiky tail. Do you think the Stegosaurus is scarier than the T-Rex?
No way! The Stegosaurus isn’t scary, it’s… like, a plant-eater, no? The T-Rex can *eat* you, that's why is more scary, and it has big teeths! Do you think the T-Rex hunted in groups, or alone?

You're absolutely right, a plant-eater isn't scary! The T-Rex had big teeth, which makes it even more frightening. That is a great question about hunting; I think they hunted alone because they were so powerful. What do you think?

eval.verdict: Profe cálido, recasts implícitos impecables (have→has, teeths→teeth sin acusar). Buen reciclado en turnos 2-3. Detalle: primer pivot a 'coolest' siente artificial cuando el alumno habla de 'strongest'.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of the dinosaurs. Look, I have a big dino toy here! Tell me, what is your favorite dinosaur?
Umm... I think... the Triceratops is... good. They have, like, three horns, yeah? It's kinda cool, but I was drawing a robot yesterday, it had lasers.

Wow, a robot with lasers sounds amazing! I bet that was fun to draw. And I think the Triceratops is an awesome dinosaur because of its three horns. What was your robot doing while you were drawing it?
Uh... my robot... he was, um, fighting a... a big monster. It wasn’t a dinosaur, it was more like a... a space alien, I think. Is the Triceratops a herbivore?

That is a brilliant idea for a drawing! Yes, the Triceratops is a herbivore, so it eats plants. I think it is fascinating because it uses those three horns to protect itself from predators. Do you like dinosaurs that eat plants or meat?
Umm... meat-eaters are more... strong, I guess. But my dog, he eats meat too, and he's kinda silly sometimes, he chases his tail.

That is so funny! Your dog sounds like a real explorer. I think meat-eaters are strong too, but herbivores are very impressive. Since you like strong animals, do you think a T-Rex would be stronger than your robot?

eval.verdict: Profe cálido, sigue el hilo del alumno con validación genuina. Podría recircular vocab más deliberadamente y evitar forzar retorno al tema.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of the dinosaurs. Look, I have a big dino toy here! What kind of dinosaur do you like the most?

eval.verdict: Coach genuino, celebra razonamiento profundo, input calibrado i+1, recasts suaves e implícitos. Reciclado podría ser más explícito.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to explore the world of dinosaurs. Look, I found a big dino egg hidden in the forest. Do you think a big dino is inside it?

eval.verdict: Profe cálido, celebra intentos y recircula vocab del alumno. Apertura con tono de script; momentos leves de quiz-like ('Do you agree...'), pero conversación fluye genuina e invita a producir.

conv.text: Hi there! I am Nova, and today we are traveling back in time to the world of the dinosaurs. Look, I have a big dino in my binoculars! What do you see in our adventure today?
Wow, look at that big dino, it’s huge and its skin is like a greenish‑gray color, I think it’s a stegosaurus maybe? And also... maybe we can see some cute little pterodactyls flying around too!

eval.verdict: Fluida, muy afectuosa, baja ansiedad. Invita bien a producir. Pero reciclado mínimo de vocab clave (herbivore, stegosaurus solo una vez) y poco desafío i+1; la clase es segura pero no evoluciona el nivel.
